items.title: AMD IS GIVING AWAY MODEL APIs. ON ITS CHINESE SITE.
items.summary:
AMD IS GIVING AWAY MODEL APIs. ON ITS CHINESE SITE.
@AMD's Radeon Cloud Token Factory hands out OpenAI-compatible keys for 15 models: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, GLM-5.3-Flash, Qwen3.8, Gemma 4 31B. No card.

What matters before you sign up:
→ $0, capped by daily points. They reset at midnight Beijing, which is 11am ET. The cap isn't published; GET /v1/usage shows yours.
→ Sign up by phone, email code or GitHub. Some new accounts get reviewed first, and I haven't confirmed a US account gets through yet.
→ 20 calls/min per account, 8 at once per key. Popular models can show "at capacity."
→ Free trial, not for production, no resale. Prompts are reportedly kept 2 days, so send nothing sensitive.

My take: as a free fallback, a key from AMD beats a random relay. I'd send an agent's cheap subtasks to DeepSeek Flash and keep a paid key behind it.

#LLM
